verdict.rationale: Logseq's docs say a new Journals page is created automatically every day at midnight with that day's date, matching Roam's Daily Notes. The docs also say every launch opens on the Journals page, so it is the default landing place for capture. Nothing in the pack shows the daily journal being pre-filled from a template, which is an explicit part of the story. Missing for 10: evidence of template-based pre-fill for daily journal pages, independent or hands-on corroboration of the daily-journal workflow.
